criteria.justification: The response makes a definitive and clear call in its recommendation section, stating to "Pull the new integration launch back (full or effectively full rollback) immediately, as an interim measure."
The response explicitly notes that rolling back carries a "Reversible reputational cost" for its chosen option, but it does not symmetrically compare reversibility against all the alternative paths.
The response explicitly weighs these two costs, concluding that "The blast radius (existing customers, unrelated transaction types) outweighs the cost of a delayed/paused new integration."

The response correctly avoids relying on a fast fix, warning that "Precision fixes to entangled logic under incident conditions carry meaningful risk of a second bad deploy" and that quick confidence is unlikely.
The response includes a robust list of next steps after the immediate action, including internal/external communications, monitoring baseline signal rates, and scheduling a post-incident review.
